articles.title: Funny 'Barry Loser' Books Are Being Turned Into a Cartoon
articles.summary: The bestselling 'Barry Loser' children's books are being made into an animated TV series, with production aimed for 2027.

articles.title: Two K-Pop Stars Team Up for Their First Duo Album
articles.summary: Jeonghan and Joshua of the K-pop group Seventeen have released 'Dreamscape,' their first album as the duo JxJ.

articles.title: Rock Stars Help a Music School for Kids Celebrate 25 Years
articles.summary: Red Hot Chili Peppers and Foo Fighters played a benefit concert for a Los Angeles music school that gives lessons to kids, including free lessons.
